cases.title: Verify existence of Classic and Modern themes under themes preferences
cases.description: Preconditions: The browser application is running. Steps: Access the themes preferences section. Expected: Both Classic and Modern themes exist under the themes preferences.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences menu item availability
cases.description: Preconditions: The browser application is running. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: The Theme Preferences item is available under the View menu.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes menu item availability
cases.description: Preconditions: The browser application is running. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: The Get New Themes item is available under the View menu.

cases.title: Verify Classic menu item availability
cases.description: Preconditions: The browser application is running. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: The Classic item is available under the View menu.

cases.title: Verify Modern menu item availability
cases.description: Preconditions: The browser application is running. Steps: Click on the View menu. Expected: The Modern item is available under the View menu.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display
cases.description: Preconditions: The Firefox application is open and themes are accessible. Steps: Select the Classic theme under theme preferences. Expected: Classic theme shall be displayed as in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Modern theme display
cases.description: Preconditions: The Firefox application is open and themes are accessible. Steps: Select the Modern theme under theme preferences. Expected: Modern theme shall be displayed as in the given image.

opinions.feedback: Cases G-006 and G-007 reference 'given image' which is missing or ambiguous, making them untestable. Cases G-004 and G-005 test View menu items for Classic and Modern themes, but the requirements R-180 and R-181 only state that the items shall be available without detailing how to verify them against an external reference, though they are testable as direct menu presence checks. However, G-006 and G-007 are insufficiently specified due to the missing image reference.
confirmed_blockers: Case G-006 depends on a 'given image' which is missing, making the expected behavior untestable.

analysis.analysis: For R-176: Preconditions: The Firefox application is open and themes are accessible; Action: Select the Classic theme under theme preferences; Expected Behavior: The Classic theme is displayed. For R-177: Preconditions: The Firefox application is open and themes are accessible; Action: Select the Modern theme under theme preferences; Expected Behavior: The Modern theme is displayed.
